# nocthost_regions (Data Source)

Regions (cities) where a server can be deployed right now, with the clouds and size categories offered in each and the starting price. Reads the public catalog (`GET /public/v1/deployable`), so no API token is needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every region that can take a deploy right now. No API token needed.
data "nocthost_regions" "all" {}

# Only Hetzner regions in Europe.
data "nocthost_regions" "hetzner_eu" {
  provider_id = "hetzner"
  continent   = "Europe"
}

output "hetzner_eu_cities" {
  value = [for r in data.nocthost_regions.hetzner_eu.regions : "${r.id}: ${r.city}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `continent` (String) Only return regions on this continent (for example `Europe`, `North America`, `Asia`). Case-insensitive.
- `provider_id` (String) Only return regions offered by this cloud backend (for example `hetzner`), and only that cloud's offers in them.

### Read-Only

- `generated_at` (String) When the catalog was generated.
- `regions` (Attributes List) Matching regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City name.
- `continent` (String) Continent.
- `id` (String) Region code to use as `region_id` on `nocthost_server`.
- `offers` (Attributes List) Clouds and size categories available in this region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions--offers))

<a id="nestedatt--regions--offers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions.offers`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Size category ID: `shared`, `dedicated`, `gpu` or `metal`.
- `category_name` (String) Size category name.
- `from_hourly_usd` (Number) Cheapest hourly price in USD.
- `from_monthly_usd` (Number) Cheapest monthly price in USD.
- `provider_id` (String) Cloud backend ID to use as `provider_id` on `nocthost_server`.
- `provider_name` (String) Cloud backend name.
- `sizes` (Number) Number of sizes offered.
